name: Appartement Villa Björn
beschreibung: Appartement Villa Björn is situated in the mountain village of Strengen in Tyrol. The holiday apartment enjoys a peaceful setting with views of the surrounding alpine peaks. In just a few minutes, guests can reach local hiking trails and, during the winter season, the surrounding ski areas. The apartment property features a cosy lounge area and a kitchenette. Dedicated parking spaces are available on-site.
